blocks.content: 4. Sort the vector using the counting vector
Now based on the value of the counting vector, we will create a sorted vector.
We will go through the counting vector sequentially and append each of its indexes to a new vector based on the value in that index.
The indices 0, 1, and 2 all have the values 0. So, we insert them 0 times in a new sorted vector. Meaning we don't insert these elements in our new vector.
